body: Integrated sugar miller: 27,000 TCD at Barkatpur (8,500), Shermau (6,000), Khaikheri (5,500) in western UP and Libberheri (7,000) in Uttarakhand; 300 KLPD molasses distilleries (250 Barkatpur, 50 Libberheri; B-heavy/syrup rating), 122 MW co-generation, 83.73% of Uttam Distilleries Ltd (40 KLPD grain, expanding to 160 KLPD by Mar-2027). Promoter Adlakha family 74.71% (no pledge); MD Raj Kumar Adlakha. FY26 revenue Rs 2,202 cr, PAT Rs 101 cr, EPS 26.30; 38,138,120 shares. Ratings CARE A / India Ratings A (Stable). No earnings calls. Auditor B.K. Kapur & Co. (term to 2027 AGM).
title: Uttam Sugar Mills Ltd (NSE UTTAMSUGAR, BSE 532729)
